name: Lion Finance Group PLC
summary: Lion Finance Group PLC, through its subsidiaries, provides banking and financial services with focus on the Georgian and Armenian markets. The company operates through Georgian Financial Services, Armenian Financial Services, and Other Businesses segments. The Georgian Financial Services segment provides retail banking, SME, and corporate and investment banking, and corporate center services; and brokerage and asset management services. The Armenian Financial Services offers retail banking, and investment banking services.
